title: If you have five minutes
blurb: One chapter of Malory: the Grail enters Camelot and the king starts grieving in the same scene. It is the whole argument of this portal in four paragraphs.
note: Read it with the quotation highlights on. Both highlighted passages are in the same chapter.

stops.note: Read to the end. The vessel arrives in glory in the second paragraph; by the fourth Arthur is telling Gawain the vow has nearly killed him.
Then the episode, for what the other authors do with the same scene.
